neighbours.label: Best guess: in a multi-sentence report, the boundary (comma after a fronted descriptive phrase, or a sentence-ending period) right before a clause that resumes an already-introduced subject; needs earlier context and was weak in probes

notes: Card: peaks on ',', ' The', '.\n', ' as' at clause boundaries in long documents. Probes: single sentences with a fronted phrase 0.02-0.07; three-sentence passages 0.04-0.34 (best: '...on 31 May 1918. They had the following children:' 0.34). Only passage length separated them, so the near misses here are the short versions; expect a fail or a weak result.
